comments.content: [medium] Right now the implementation only triggers a failure on `HitResult.IgnoreMiss` for slider tails. It would be worth aligning with the existing OsuHealthProcessor logic, which treats any non-hit result (!result.IsHit) on slider tails as significant — this would keep the behavior consistent and avoid situations where some kinds of slider tail misses fail to trigger sudden death.
[low] The behavior around `FailCondition` would be clearer if its precondition were stated at the boundary.
